title: Cross-agent iteration roadmap normalization
summary: Promoted the cross-agent Codex and Claude Code diagnosis into repository-owned planning norms before downstream implementation. The roadmap records user intent, current bottlenecks, dependency order, independently verifiable slices, and explicit non-goals so future agents do not depend on chat memory.

validation_commands: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='docs/ai-daily-cross-agent-iteration-roadmap.md'; if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('missing cross-agent iteration roadmap'); process.exit(1)} const s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'); for (const phrase of ['Highest Priority','Dependency Order','Independently Verifiable','Not In This Phase']) { if(!s.includes(phrase)){ console.error('missing '+phrase); process.exit(1) } }"

lessons.lesson: Cross-agent diagnosis must be promoted into repository-owned norms before it can steer implementation.
lessons.evidence: The new roadmap is linked from requirements reconciliation, ledger scope, quick reference, unit tests, and this retrospective.
lessons.recommended_action: Begin future ai-daily improvement work by reviewing the roadmap dependency order before editing generation, source, publish, or rendering code.

lessons.lesson: The next implementation slices need dependency-aware validation, not another flat ROI list.
lessons.evidence: The roadmap separates real artifact validation, admission/scoring, authoring, GitHub Trending, source lanes, automation observability, and frontend IA by dependency and independent verification boundary.
lessons.recommended_action: Implement the next slices one at a time, starting with real artifact validation before broader generation changes.

suggestions.issue: Cross-agent intent and project diagnosis can be lost when they remain only in chat or local memory.
suggestions.evidence: The user explicitly reprioritized the prior recommendation so repository-owned memory and norms become the first step.
suggestions.suggestion: Keep `docs/ai-daily-cross-agent-iteration-roadmap.md` as the durable planning entry point for ai-daily improvement work.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future iterations should start from accepted dependency order and verification boundaries instead of rediscovering the same project pain.
suggestions.promotion_path: Already promoted through REQ-013, ledger scope, quick reference, unit tests, and retrospective index.

followups.action: Implement the real artifact validation slice before admission, authoring, source, or frontend changes.
Treat frontend IA as dependent on content/admission improvements unless the user explicitly asks for a visual-only pass.
